title: wktasklist: tasklist.exe full compatibility and self-test
desc: Complete wktasklist.ps1 upgrade: /FO TABLE/LIST/CSV, /V verbose, /FI filters with range operators (MEMUSAGE> CPUUSAGE>), -Test auto-validation
steps: Add -FO parameter support for TABLE LIST CSV formats
Implement Format-AsTable, Format-AsList, Format-AsCsv output functions
Add regex-based filter parser supporting FIELD OPERATOR VALUE syntax
Implement MEMUSAGE and CPUUSAGE range filters with > < >= <= operators
Add USERNAME and extended filter operator support
Create Test-WkTaskList function with 12 filter test cases
Add -Test flag to run automated validation and report results

requirements.expect: Table output with PID NAME MB CMD columns
CSV header plus process data rows
PASSED X/12 summary line with checkmark

author: claude
